ai: Samuel is a prophet who appears in the Hebrew Bible.
撒母耳是出現在希伯來聖經中的一位先知。
The story of Samuel is told in two books of the Bible.
撒母耳的故事記載在聖經的兩卷書中。
My cousin named his baby boy Samuel last spring.
我表哥去年春天把他的寶寶取名叫塞繆爾。
Samuel waved at us from across the street.
塞繆爾在街道對面向我們揮手。
Vienna is the capital of Austria.
維也納是奧地利的首都。
We spent a weekend in Vienna listening to classical music.
我們在維也納度過一個週末，聽了古典音樂。
The train to Vienna leaves from platform four.
開往維也納的火車從四號月台出發。

pence.zh: 便士（英國貨幣單位，penny 的複數）
ai: The candy costs fifty pence at the corner shop.
這種糖在街角商店要五十便士。
I found a few pence on the floor of the bus.
我在公車地板上撿到幾個便士。
A pound is worth one hundred pence.
一英鎊等於一百便士。
The carter loaded the sacks of flour onto his wagon.
那位馬車伕把幾袋麵粉裝上他的貨車。
In the old days, a carter delivered goods between villages.
從前，馬車伕負責在村落之間運送貨物。
Ron is always the first person to arrive at the office.
朗恩總是第一個到辦公室的人。
I asked Ron if he could give me a ride home.
我問朗恩能不能載我回家。
Harvey plays guitar in a small band on weekends.
哈維週末會在一個小樂團裡彈吉他。
Have you met Harvey, the new engineer on our team?
你見過我們團隊的新工程師哈維了嗎？
Joyce baked a lemon cake for her neighbors.
喬伊斯為鄰居烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。
I'll ask Joyce to help us plan the trip.
我會請喬伊斯幫我們規劃這趟旅行。

derby.zh: 德比賽馬（英國著名的年度賽馬）
ai: Thousands of fans gather every year to watch the Derby.
每年都有數以千計的球迷聚集觀看德比賽馬。
The horse trained for months before running in the Derby.
這匹馬在參加德比賽馬之前訓練了好幾個月。

derby.zh: 德比（英格蘭中部的城市）
ai: Derby is a city in the middle of England.
德比是英格蘭中部的一座城市。
She grew up in Derby before moving to London.
她在德比長大，後來才搬到倫敦。
Craig volunteered to carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
克雷格自願把沉重的箱子搬上樓。
Craig and I have been friends since middle school.
克雷格和我從國中起就是朋友。

preston.zh: 普勒斯頓（英格蘭西北部城市）
ai: Preston is a city in the north-west of England.
普勒斯頓是英格蘭西北部的一座城市。
We took a train from Preston to Manchester.
我們搭火車從普勒斯頓前往曼徹斯特。
Preston is helping his sister study for the exam.
普勒斯頓正在幫他妹妹準備考試。
They named their puppy Preston.
他們把小狗取名叫普勒斯頓。

pete.zh: 皮特（男子名，Peter 的暱稱）
ai: Pete makes the best pancakes on Sunday mornings.
皮特週日早上做的鬆餅最好吃。
Pete forgot his umbrella again, so he got wet.
皮特又忘了帶傘，所以淋濕了。

wimbledon.zh: 溫布頓（倫敦的一個地區，以網球賽聞名）
ai: Wimbledon is a district in the southwest of London.
溫布頓是倫敦西南部的一個地區。
The Wimbledon tennis tournament is held every summer.
溫布頓網球錦標賽每年夏天舉行。
She dreams of playing on the grass courts at Wimbledon.
她夢想在溫布頓的草地球場上比賽。
The rover sent photos of the red surface back to Earth.
探測車把紅色地表的照片傳回地球。
Scientists drove the rover slowly across the rocky ground.
科學家操控探測車慢慢駛過多石的地面。
He was a rover who never stayed in one town for long.
他是個四處漫遊的人，從不在同一個小鎮久留。
The old rover told us stories about the places he had seen.
那位老漫遊者跟我們講了他看過的各地故事。

ali.zh: 阿里（常見的男子名或姓氏）
ai: Ali is the goalkeeper on our school's soccer team.
阿里是我們學校足球隊的守門員。
Ali invited all of us to his sister's wedding.
阿里邀請我們所有人參加他姐姐的婚禮。
A greater number of people came to the event this year.
今年來參加活動的人數更多。
The city's greater need is for more affordable housing.
這座城市更迫切的需求是更多負擔得起的住房。
She felt that helping others was a greater goal than making money.
她覺得幫助別人是比賺錢更崇高的目標。
There is no greater joy than seeing your child succeed.
沒有什麼比看到孩子成功更令人高興了。

kim.zh: 金姆（常見的人名或姓氏）
ai: Kim is studying to become a nurse.
金姆正在讀書準備成為護理師。
I saved a seat for Kim at the front of the room.
我幫金姆在教室前面留了一個位子。

lordship.zh: 閣下（對貴族或法官的尊稱，his/your lordship）
ai: The servant bowed and said, "Your lordship, dinner is ready."
僕人鞠躬說：「閣下，晚餐準備好了。」
The lawyer thanked his lordship for the patient hearing.
律師感謝閣下耐心聽取陳述。
The lordship of the land passed to his eldest son.
這片土地的領主權傳給了他的長子。
The village lived under the lordship of a powerful family.
這個村莊受一個有權勢的家族統治。

willie.zh: 威利（男子名，William 的暱稱）
ai: Willie fixed our bike chain in just five minutes.
威利五分鐘就把我們的腳踏車鏈條修好了。
Everyone at the party was happy to see Willie again.
派對上每個人都很高興再次見到威利。
Lisa runs five kilometers every morning before work.
麗莎每天上班前都跑五公里。
I borrowed this book from Lisa last week.
我上週向麗莎借了這本書。
Sophie painted the walls of her room bright yellow.
索菲把她房間的牆壁漆成鮮黃色。
Sophie is learning to speak Japanese this year.
索菲今年正在學日語。
Sara is organizing a surprise party for her mother.
莎拉正在為她媽媽籌辦驚喜派對。
Please tell Sara that the meeting starts at ten.
請告訴莎拉會議十點開始。

gabriel.zh: 加百列（聖經中的天使長）
ai: In the Bible, the angel Gabriel brings important messages.
在聖經中，天使加百列負責傳達重要的訊息。
The painting shows Gabriel with large white wings.
這幅畫描繪了長著白色大翅膀的加百列。
Gabriel brought homemade bread to the picnic.
加百列帶了自製的麵包來野餐。
Our new classmate Gabriel moved here from Spain.
我們的新同學加百列是從西班牙搬來的。
Isabel always keeps a small notebook in her bag.
伊莎貝爾包包裡總是放著一本小筆記本。
We waited for Isabel at the station for twenty minutes.
我們在車站等了伊莎貝爾二十分鐘。
Using a map made the trip much easier.
使用地圖讓這趟旅程輕鬆多了。
This problem is easier than the one we solved yesterday.
這個問題比我們昨天解的那題簡單。
It's easier to learn a language when you practice every day.
每天練習的話，學語言會比較容易。
The museum has an old pistol from the eighteenth century.
博物館收藏了一把十八世紀的老手槍。
Police officers must store a pistol in a locked case.
警察必須把手槍存放在上鎖的箱子裡。
The runners waited for the starter to fire the pistol.
選手們等待發令員開信號槍。
A loud shot from the starting pistol began the race.
起跑信號槍的一聲巨響宣告比賽開始。

chopped.zh: 切碎、剁碎（chop 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She chopped the onions and added them to the soup.
她把洋蔥切碎，加進湯裡。
We chopped some wood for the fireplace this morning.
今天早上我們劈了一些柴給壁爐用。
Add the chopped garlic when the oil is hot.
油熱了之後，再加入切碎的大蒜。
Considering the weather, the trip went quite well.
考慮到天氣，這趟旅行算是相當順利。
He runs fast, considering how little he trains.
考慮到他很少訓練，他跑得算快了。

considering.zh: 正在考慮（consider 的現在分詞）
ai: I'm considering a job in a different city.
我正在考慮去另一個城市工作。
She is considering whether to join the club.
她正在考慮要不要加入社團。
We tried an Iranian dish made with rice and herbs.
我們嚐了一道用米飯和香草做成的伊朗菜。
The museum has a large collection of Iranian carpets.
這間博物館有大量的伊朗地毯收藏。
An Iranian student gave a talk about her hometown.
一位伊朗學生分享了她家鄉的故事。
My neighbor is an Iranian who teaches at the university.
我的鄰居是一位在大學任教的伊朗人。
Marijuana is legal in some places but illegal in others.
大麻在有些地方合法，在其他地方卻是違法的。
Doctors are still studying how marijuana affects the brain.
醫生仍在研究大麻如何影響大腦。
The old church has a beautiful blue dome.
那座老教堂有一個美麗的藍色圓頂。
Tourists climbed to the top of the dome to see the city.
遊客爬到圓頂頂端俯瞰整座城市。
The stadium has a huge dome that covers the whole field.
那座體育館有個巨大的圓頂，覆蓋了整個球場。
People say a ghost haunts the old house on the hill.
人們說山上那棟老房子鬧鬼。
The story is about a lady who haunts the castle at night.
這個故事講的是一位夜裡在城堡裡出沒的女士。
The memory of that mistake still haunts him.
那個錯誤的回憶仍然縈繞在他心頭。
Fear of failure can haunt you for years.
對失敗的恐懼可能會困擾你好多年。
This café is a favorite haunt of local students.
這間咖啡館是當地學生最愛去的地方。
The park was his old haunt when he was a boy.
那座公園是他小時候常去的地方。
The fireworks over the harbor were a wonderful spectacle.
港口上空的煙火是個美妙的壯觀景象。
Thousands of birds taking off at once was quite a spectacle.
成千上萬隻鳥同時起飛，場面十分壯觀。

spectacle.zh: 丟臉的場面（make a spectacle of oneself）
ai: He made a spectacle of himself by shouting at the waiter.
他對著服務生大吼大叫，鬧了個大笑話。
Don't make a spectacle of yourself at the wedding.
在婚禮上別讓自己出醜。
My grandfather wears spectacles when he reads the newspaper.
我爺爺看報紙時會戴眼鏡。
She cleaned her spectacles with a soft cloth.
她用軟布擦拭她的眼鏡。

sheriff.zh: 郡治安官（美國地方執法首長）
ai: The sheriff asked the neighbors if they had seen anything.
郡治安官詢問鄰居們有沒有看到什麼。
In many Western movies, the sheriff wears a silver star.
在許多西部電影裡，治安官會戴著銀色星形徽章。
The county voted for a new sheriff last November.
這個郡去年十一月選出了新的治安官。
She felt miserable after losing her favorite necklace.
她弄丟最喜歡的項鍊後覺得非常難過。
He was miserable at his old job and finally quit.
他在以前的工作很痛苦，最後辭職了。

miserable.zh: 糟糕的、令人不舒服的（天氣、環境）
ai: It was a cold, miserable day with rain all afternoon.
那是個又冷又糟的日子，整個下午都在下雨。
We spent a miserable night in a tent with no heater.
我們在沒有暖氣的帳篷裡度過了難受的一夜。
The stray dog lived a miserable life on the streets.
那隻流浪狗在街頭過著悲慘的生活。
They lived in miserable conditions before the storm ended.
在風暴結束前，他們處在悲慘的處境中。
The smell of fresh bread evokes memories of my grandmother's kitchen.
新鮮麵包的香味喚起我對外婆廚房的回憶。
The old photo evoked a feeling of sadness in her.
那張老照片讓她心裡湧起一股悲傷。
Good music can evoke strong emotions.
好音樂能喚起強烈的情緒。
The test was comparatively easy this time.
這次的考試相對比較簡單。
Rent here is comparatively cheap for a big city.
以大城市來說，這裡的房租相對便宜。
The company is comparatively new, but it is growing fast.
這家公司相對較新，但成長得很快。
The plan went ahead with the backing of the whole community.
這項計畫在全社區的支持下順利推動。
She needs financial backing to open her own shop.
她需要資金上的支持才能開自己的店。

backing.zh: 伴奏（演唱時的背景樂聲）
ai: The singer had a great backing band behind her.
那位歌手身後有一支很棒的伴奏樂隊。
The backing vocals made the chorus sound much fuller.
和聲讓副歌聽起來豐滿許多。

backing.zh: 倒車、後退（back 的現在分詞）
ai: He was backing the car out of the garage when it started to rain.
他正把車從車庫倒出來時，開始下雨了。
The little boy kept backing away from the barking dog.
小男孩不斷往後退，遠離那隻吠叫的狗。
The surviving members of the band met again after twenty years.
樂團尚在世的成員二十年後再度相聚。
Only a few surviving copies of the book remain today.
這本書如今只剩少數幾本留存下來。

surviving.zh: 存活、倖存（survive 的現在分詞）
ai: Surviving in the desert requires plenty of water.
在沙漠中生存需要大量的水。
The plants are surviving the cold winter surprisingly well.
這些植物出乎意料地撐過了寒冷的冬天。
The chemist spent years studying how plastics break down.
這位化學家花了好幾年研究塑膠如何分解。
My aunt is a chemist who works in a research lab.
我阿姨是在研究實驗室工作的化學家。
I picked up my medicine at the chemist's on the corner.
我在街角的藥房拿了我的藥。
The chemist explained how often I should take the tablets.
藥劑師解釋了我該多久吃一次藥。
The sharp nail penetrated the thick wooden board.
尖銳的釘子穿透了厚木板。
Sunlight cannot penetrate the dense forest canopy.
陽光無法穿透茂密的林冠。
The cold air penetrated my thin jacket.
冷空氣滲進了我單薄的外套。
The company is trying to penetrate the Asian market.
這家公司正試圖打進亞洲市場。
Our school's ranking improved a lot this year.
我們學校今年的排名進步了很多。
The ranking of the top ten players changes every week.
前十名選手的排名每週都會變動。
The ranking officer gave the order to leave.
階級最高的軍官下令離開。
She is the ranking member of the committee.
她是這個委員會中資歷最高的成員。
A helicopter hovered above the rooftop for several minutes.
一架直升機在屋頂上方盤旋了好幾分鐘。
Hummingbirds can hover in front of a flower while they drink.
蜂鳥能在花前懸停著吸食花蜜。
The waiter hovered near our table, waiting for us to order.
服務生在我們桌邊徘徊，等著我們點餐。
Her mother hovered in the doorway while she studied.
她讀書時，媽媽一直在門口徘徊。
The drone stayed in a steady hover over the field.
無人機穩穩地懸停在田野上空。
The bird's hover lasted only a few seconds.
那隻鳥只懸停了幾秒鐘。
The view from the mountain top was absolutely stunning.
山頂上的景色美得令人驚豔。
She wore a stunning red dress to the party.
她穿著一件亮眼的紅色洋裝去參加派對。
The team's stunning defeat surprised all the fans.
球隊令人震驚的落敗讓所有球迷都很意外。
We received stunning news about the company this morning.
我們今天早上收到了關於公司的震撼消息。
We caught two trout in the cold mountain stream.
我們在冰冷的山溪裡釣到兩條鱒魚。
The restaurant serves grilled trout with lemon.
這間餐廳供應檸檬烤鱒魚。
Trout live in clean, fast-flowing water.
鱒魚生活在乾淨、流速快的水中。
He follows an orthodox approach to teaching math.
他採用傳統的方式教數學。
The doctor suggested a less orthodox treatment for the pain.
醫生建議用一種比較不傳統的方法治療疼痛。
Her orthodox views surprised her more modern friends.
她保守傳統的看法讓比較新潮的朋友們很驚訝。

latino.zh: 拉丁裔男性、拉丁美洲裔的人
ai: He is a Latino who grew up in Texas.
他是在德州長大的拉丁裔。
The Latino community held a food festival downtown.
拉丁裔社群在市中心舉辦了美食節。
The cowboy rode across the field to check on the cattle.
牛仔騎馬穿越原野去查看牛群。
My little brother dressed as a cowboy for Halloween.
我弟弟萬聖節時扮成牛仔。
Many old Western movies are about a lonely cowboy.
許多老西部片都在講一位孤單的牛仔。
A seagull swooped down and snatched the sandwich from my hand.
一隻海鷗俯衝下來，從我手中叼走了三明治。
The child snatched the toy away from his sister.
那個孩子從妹妹手中把玩具搶了過去。
I snatched a quick nap before the meeting.
我在會議前趁機小睡了一會兒。
She snatched the chance to speak with the director.
她抓住了和導演說話的機會。
The thief made a quick snatch at her bag.
小偷迅速地搶了她的包包一下。
I only caught a snatch of their conversation.
我只聽到他們談話的片段。
There are countless stars in the sky tonight.
今晚天上有無數的星星。
She has answered countless questions from the students.
她已經回答過學生們無數的問題。
The old library holds countless books on history.
這間老圖書館收藏了無數的歷史書。

selling.zh: 賣、銷售（sell 的現在分詞）
ai: He is selling his old bicycle online.
他正在網路上賣他的舊腳踏車。
The shop is selling fresh fruit at half price today.
這家店今天把新鮮水果半價出售。
Selling used books helped her earn some extra money.
賣二手書讓她賺了一些額外的錢。
He is good at selling, so he works in a sales team.
他很擅長銷售，所以在業務團隊工作。

virginia.zh: 維吉尼亞（美國東部的一個州）
ai: Virginia is a state on the east coast of the United States.
維吉尼亞是美國東岸的一個州。
We drove through Virginia on our way to Florida.
我們在前往佛羅里達的途中開車經過維吉尼亞。
Virginia has been teaching piano for over thirty years.
維吉尼亞教鋼琴已經超過三十年了。
They named their daughter Virginia after her grandmother.
他們依據祖母的名字，把女兒取名為維吉尼亞。
Our office is on the ninth floor of the building.
我們的辦公室在大樓的九樓。
She finished ninth in the city's marathon.
她在市馬拉松賽中跑了第九名。
The ninth of May is my brother's birthday.
五月九日是我哥哥的生日。
A ninth of the cake was left on the plate.
盤子裡剩下蛋糕的九分之一。
He ate only a ninth of the pizza and gave the rest away.
他只吃了披薩的九分之一，其餘的都送人了。
I tied a tight knot in the rope.
我在繩子上打了一個緊緊的結。
It took me a long time to untie the knot in my shoelace.
我花了很久才解開鞋帶上的結。
A knot of people stood outside the shop waiting for it to open.
一小群人站在店外等著開門。
My stomach was in a knot before the speech.
演講前我的胃緊張得糾結成一團。
She knotted the scarf around her neck.
她把圍巾在脖子上打了個結。
The wire was knotted so badly that I couldn't use it.
那條電線纏得太嚴重，我沒辦法用。
I can't remember the lyrics to that song.
我想不起來那首歌的歌詞。
The lyrics are about missing someone far away.
這些歌詞是在講思念遠方的人。
She wrote the lyrics and her brother composed the music.
歌詞是她寫的，音樂則由她哥哥作曲。
Gambling can quickly become a serious problem.
賭博很快就可能變成嚴重的問題。
Gambling is not allowed in many countries.
許多國家不允許賭博。
He lost all his savings to gambling.
他把所有積蓄都輸在賭博上了。
Harold retired last year and now spends his time gardening.
哈羅德去年退休，現在把時間都花在園藝上。
Harold lent me his ladder for the weekend.
哈羅德把他的梯子借我用一個週末。
Modern warfare relies heavily on technology.
現代戰爭高度依賴科技。
The museum shows how warfare changed over the centuries.
博物館展示了戰爭在數百年間如何演變。
The two companies are engaged in price warfare.
這兩家公司正陷入價格戰。
There was constant warfare between the two rival gangs.
這兩個敵對幫派之間紛爭不斷。
The children climbed to the top of the grassy mound.
孩子們爬上了長滿草的小土丘。
A mound of dirt was left beside the hole.
洞旁邊留下了一堆泥土。
There was a mound of laundry waiting on the bed.
床上堆了一大堆待洗的衣服。
He left a mound of dishes in the sink.
他在水槽裡留了一大堆碗盤。
The farmers mounded the soil around the young plants.
農夫把土堆在幼苗周圍。
Snow mounded up against the garage door overnight.
雪一夜之間在車庫門邊堆成了一堆。
She tilted her head and listened carefully.
她歪著頭仔細聆聽。
Don't tilt the glass or the water will spill.
別把杯子傾斜，不然水會灑出來。
The old table tilts to one side because a leg is shorter.
那張舊桌子因為有一隻腳比較短，所以會往一邊傾斜。
The tower has a slight tilt to the left.
這座塔略微向左傾斜。
With a tilt of her hat, she greeted us.
她把帽子輕輕一傾，向我們打了招呼。
Two men tried to rob the small bank downtown.
兩名男子企圖搶劫市中心的那家小銀行。
The shop was robbed late at night, but no one was hurt.
那家店在深夜遭搶，但沒有人受傷。

rob.zh: 剝奪、使失去（rob someone of something）
ai: The long illness robbed him of his strength.
那場長期的病痛使他失去了體力。
Don't let worry rob you of a good night's sleep.
別讓煩惱剝奪你一夜好眠。
Herbert has lived in this village all his life.
赫伯特一輩子都住在這個村子裡。
Herbert showed us how to plant tomatoes.
赫伯特示範給我們看怎麼種番茄。
Her advocacy for clean water helped many villages.
她對乾淨水源的倡導幫助了許多村莊。
The group is known for its advocacy of animal rights.
這個團體以倡導動物權利聞名。
Strong advocacy by parents led to a new school library.
家長們的積極倡導促成了一座新的學校圖書館。
The two countries are arguing over a territorial dispute.
這兩個國家正在為領土爭端而爭吵。
The territorial waters extend twelve nautical miles from the coast.
領海從海岸向外延伸十二海里。

territorial.zh: 有地盤意識的、護地盤的
ai: My cat is very territorial and hisses at strangers.
我的貓很有地盤意識，會對陌生人嘶叫。
Some birds become territorial during the nesting season.
有些鳥類在築巢季節會變得保護地盤。
The baron lived in a large stone castle.
那位男爵住在一座大石頭城堡裡。
In the story, the baron invites the villagers to a feast.
故事中，男爵邀請村民們參加宴會。
The oil baron donated money to the new hospital.
那位石油大亨捐錢給新醫院。
He became a media baron after buying several newspapers.
他買下幾家報社後成了媒體大亨。
The turner shaped the metal part on his lathe.
車工用車床把金屬零件加工成形。
A skilled turner can make a perfect wooden bowl.
熟練的車工能做出完美的木碗。
The inland areas are usually colder than the coast.
內陸地區通常比海岸地區冷。
We visited a small inland village far from the sea.
我們造訪了一個遠離海邊的內陸小村莊。
We drove inland to avoid the crowded beaches.
我們開車往內陸去，躲開擁擠的海灘。
The storm moved inland and lost much of its strength.
暴風雨移往內陸後減弱了許多。
Most of the country's farms are in the inland.
這個國家的大部分農場都位於內陸地區。
They traveled deep into the inland by horse.
他們騎馬深入內陸地區旅行。
The creator of this cartoon also draws the comic books.
這部卡通的創作者也負責畫漫畫書。
The website lets every creator share videos with fans.
這個網站讓每位創作者都能和粉絲分享影片。
Many believe that the Creator made the world and everything in it.
許多人相信造物主創造了世界與其中的萬物。
They prayed to their Creator for peace.
他們向造物主祈求和平。

lancaster.zh: 蘭開斯特（英格蘭西北部的城市）
ai: Lancaster is a historic city in the north-west of England.
蘭開斯特是英格蘭西北部的一座歷史名城。
There is a university in Lancaster that many students attend.
蘭開斯特有一所許多學生就讀的大學。
The candles glowed softly in the dark room.
蠟燭在黑暗的房間裡散發著柔和的光。
The stars on the ceiling glow after the lights go out.
燈熄滅後，天花板上的星星會發光。
The bride seemed to glow with happiness.
新娘看起來因幸福而容光煥發。
His face glowed with pride when he won the prize.
他得獎時臉上洋溢著驕傲的光彩。
We saw the warm glow of the fire through the window.
我們從窗外看到爐火溫暖的光亮。
A soft glow spread across the sky at sunrise.
日出時，一道柔和的光輝灑滿天空。

unacceptable.zh: 無法接受的、不可容忍的
ai: Being late every day is unacceptable.
每天遲到是不能接受的。
The company said such behavior is unacceptable.
公司表示這樣的行為是不可容忍的。
The noise from the street was unacceptable at night.
晚上街上的噪音讓人無法接受。
The bag looked real, but it was fake.
那個包包看起來像真的，其實是假的。
He showed a fake ID at the door.
他在門口出示了一張假證件。
She gave me a fake smile and walked away.
她對我假笑了一下就走開了。
The expert said the painting was a fake.
專家說這幅畫是贗品。
Be careful, because many of those watches are fakes.
要小心，因為那些手錶很多都是假貨。
He faked a cough to avoid going to school.
他假裝咳嗽，好不去上學。
They faked the signature on the document.
他們偽造了文件上的簽名。
The cooper carefully fitted the wooden strips together to make a barrel.
製桶工人仔細地把木條拼合起來做成一個木桶。
A cooper in the village made barrels for the wine makers.
村裡的一位製桶匠為釀酒人製作酒桶。

bradford.zh: 布拉德福德（英格蘭北部的城市）
ai: Bradford is a large city in the north of England.
布拉德福德是英格蘭北部的一座大城市。
Bradford was once famous for its wool industry.
布拉德福德過去以毛紡織業聞名。
It helps to listen to someone else's viewpoint before you decide.
做決定之前，先聽聽別人的觀點會有幫助。
From my viewpoint, the plan is too expensive.
從我的角度來看，這個計畫太貴了。
The article presents a different viewpoint on the issue.
這篇文章提出了對這個議題不同的看法。
We watched a small crab walk sideways along the beach.
我們看著一隻小螃蟹沿著海灘橫著走。
For dinner, we ordered steamed crab with garlic.
晚餐我們點了蒜蓉蒸螃蟹。
The crab hid under a rock when the tide came in.
漲潮時，那隻螃蟹躲到岩石底下。
He always crabs about the weather.
他老是在抱怨天氣。
Stop crabbing and help me carry these boxes.
別再發牢騷了，過來幫我搬這些箱子。
My birthday is on the seventeenth of June.
我的生日是六月十七日。
The seventeenth century saw great advances in science.
十七世紀的科學有很大的進展。
He finished seventeenth in a race of fifty runners.
在五十名選手的比賽中，他得了第十七名。

hampshire.zh: 漢普郡（英格蘭南部的一個郡）
ai: Hampshire is a county on the south coast of England.
漢普郡是英格蘭南部海岸的一個郡。
We spent a quiet weekend in the Hampshire countryside.
我們在漢普郡鄉間度過了一個安靜的週末。
Mix some vinegar and oil to make a salad dressing.
把醋和油混合，就可以做成沙拉醬。
The pickles were kept in vinegar for a week.
這些醃菜在醋裡泡了一個星期。
You can clean the window with vinegar and water.
你可以用醋和水來擦窗戶。
Boxing requires a lot of strength and good footwork.
拳擊需要很大的力氣和靈活的步法。
My uncle took up boxing to stay in shape.
我叔叔為了保持身材而開始練拳擊。
They watched the boxing match on television last night.
他們昨晚看了電視上的拳擊比賽。
The shop specialises in handmade leather bags.
這家店專門販售手工皮包。
She wants to specialise in children's medicine.
她想專攻兒童醫學。
Many students specialise after their second year of college.
許多學生在大學二年級之後會選定專攻領域。
The police finally caught the murderer after a long search.
警方經過長時間搜查，終於抓到了兇手。
In the novel, the murderer turns out to be the butler.
在這部小說裡，兇手原來是管家。
Alfred feeds the birds in the park every afternoon.
阿爾弗雷德每天下午都會到公園餵鳥。
I met Alfred at a book club last month.
我上個月在讀書會上認識了阿爾弗雷德。
Ralph is repairing the roof of his cabin.
拉爾夫正在修理他小木屋的屋頂。
Ralph and his brother share a small apartment.
拉爾夫和他弟弟合租一間小公寓。
Trevor brought sandwiches for everyone on the hike.
特雷弗在健行時為大家帶了三明治。
Trevor is saving money to buy a used car.
特雷弗正在存錢買一輛二手車。
He ordered a burger and a cold soda.
他點了一個漢堡和一杯冰汽水。
Drinking too much soda is bad for your teeth.
喝太多汽水對牙齒不好。
Can I have a soda with ice, please?
請給我一杯加冰塊的汽水好嗎？
She mixed some soda and lemon juice to make a drink.
她把蘇打水和檸檬汁混在一起調成飲料。
Baking soda is often used to make cakes rise.
小蘇打常被用來讓蛋糕膨脹。
He plays bass in a local rock band.
他在一個本地搖滾樂團裡彈貝斯。
The bass in this song makes the floor shake.
這首歌的貝斯聲讓地板都震動起來。
He sings bass in the church choir.
他在教會合唱團裡唱男低音。
The speakers have strong bass that you can feel in your chest.
這對喇叭的低音很強，你能在胸口感覺到。
We caught a large bass at the lake this morning.
今天早上我們在湖邊釣到一條大鱸魚。
The restaurant serves steamed sea bass with ginger.
這間餐廳供應薑絲蒸海鱸魚。
She polished her shoes until they were shiny.
她把鞋子擦到發亮。
The baby was playing with a shiny new coin.
寶寶正在玩一枚閃亮的新硬幣。
The car looked shiny after a good wash.
洗過車之後，這輛車看起來閃閃發亮。

suffolk.zh: 薩福克（英格蘭東部的一個郡）
ai: Suffolk is a county in the east of England.
薩福克是英格蘭東部的一個郡。
They rented a small cottage near the coast of Suffolk.
他們在薩福克的海岸附近租了一間小屋。
The children left milk and cookies out for Santa.
孩子們留了牛奶和餅乾給聖誕老人。
My father dresses up as Santa every Christmas Eve.
我爸爸每年平安夜都會扮成聖誕老人。
She wrote a letter to Santa asking for a bicycle.
她寫了一封信給聖誕老人，希望得到一輛腳踏車。
The sudden news stunned everyone in the room.
這個突如其來的消息讓房間裡的每個人都愣住了。
The size of the crowd stunned the singer.
觀眾人數之多讓那位歌手大吃一驚。
The fall stunned him for a few seconds.
這一跌讓他暈眩了好幾秒鐘。
The loud bang stunned the birds and sent them flying.
那聲巨響震懾了鳥群，讓牠們四散飛走。
Global warming is causing ice at the poles to melt.
全球暖化正使兩極的冰融化。
The warming of the climate affects farmers everywhere.
氣候變暖影響到各地的農民。

warming.zh: 加熱、變暖（warm 的現在分詞）
ai: She is warming her hands by the fire.
她正在火邊暖手。
The soup is warming on the stove right now.
湯現在正在爐子上加熱。

southampton.zh: 南安普敦（英格蘭南部的港口城市）
ai: Southampton is a port city on the south coast of England.
南安普敦是英格蘭南部海岸的一座港口城市。
Large ships often leave from Southampton for long voyages.
大型船隻常從南安普敦出發進行長途航行。
She had a soft curl of hair on her forehead.
她額頭上有一綹柔軟的捲髮。
A curl of smoke rose from the chimney.
一縷捲曲的煙從煙囪裡升起。
She curls her hair every morning before school.
她每天早上上學前都會把頭髮捲一捲。
The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
貓蜷縮在沙發上睡著了。
The paper began to curl in the heat.
紙張在高溫下開始捲了起來。
The children drew pictures with colored pencils.
孩子們用彩色鉛筆畫圖。
She hung colored lights across the living room.
她在客廳裡掛了彩色燈飾。
Do you have this notebook in a brightly colored cover?
這本筆記本有顏色鮮豔的封面嗎？
Police found a corpse in the old warehouse.
警方在舊倉庫裡發現了一具屍體。
The detective examined the corpse for clues.
偵探檢查屍體尋找線索。
The music stopped abruptly, and everyone turned around.
音樂突然停了，大家都轉過頭去。
He abruptly stood up and left the meeting.
他突然站起來，離開了會議。
The road ends abruptly at the edge of the cliff.
這條路在懸崖邊突然中斷。
Tommy rides his bike to school every day.
湯米每天騎腳踏車上學。
Tommy shared his lunch with the new student.
湯米把午餐分給新同學吃。
The city has a beautiful Gothic cathedral with tall towers.
這座城市有一座擁有高塔的美麗哥德式大教堂。
Gothic windows are tall and pointed at the top.
哥德式的窗戶高而尖頂。
The architect was famous for his use of Gothic in churches.
那位建築師以在教堂中運用哥德風格聞名。
Some people love the dark mood of Gothic in novels.
有些人喜歡小說中哥德風格的陰暗氛圍。

canterbury.zh: 坎特伯里（英格蘭東南部的城市，以大教堂聞名）
ai: Canterbury is a city in the southeast of England.
坎特伯里是英格蘭東南部的一座城市。
Thousands of visitors come to see the cathedral in Canterbury.
成千上萬的遊客來參觀坎特伯里的大教堂。
The guide carried a burning torch into the cave.
嚮導拿著燃燒的火把走進洞穴。
Runners passed the Olympic torch from one to another.
跑者們一個接一個地傳遞奧運聖火。
I used a torch to find my keys in the dark.
我用手電筒在黑暗中找我的鑰匙。
Please bring a torch in case the power goes out.
請帶一支手電筒，以防停電。
Someone torched the old shed behind the farm.
有人放火燒了農場後面的舊棚屋。
The chef torched the sugar on top of the dessert.
廚師用噴槍把甜點上的糖烤焦了。
The knight rode a white horse into the village.
騎士騎著白馬進入村莊。
In the story, a brave knight saves the princess.
故事中，一位勇敢的騎士救了公主。
The musician was made a knight by the queen.
這位音樂家被女王封為爵士。
He became a knight for his work in medicine.
他因為在醫學上的貢獻而獲封爵士。
The king knighted the soldier for his courage.
國王因這位士兵的勇氣而封他為騎士。
She was knighted for her service to the arts.
她因為對藝術的貢獻而受封爵位。

coventry.zh: 考文垂（英格蘭中部的城市）
ai: Coventry is a city in the middle of England.
考文垂是英格蘭中部的一座城市。
The cathedral in Coventry was rebuilt after the war.
考文垂的大教堂在戰後重建。
Dorothy grows roses in her small backyard.
桃樂絲在她的小後院裡種玫瑰。
Dorothy always remembers everyone's birthday.
桃樂絲總是記得每個人的生日。
The wound needs time for healing.
傷口需要時間來癒合。
Many people find walking in nature good for healing.
許多人覺得在大自然中散步有助於療癒。

healing.zh: 有療癒效果的、有助痊癒的
ai: She drank a cup of healing herbal tea.
她喝了一杯有療癒效果的草本茶。
The doctor said this cream has healing properties.
醫生說這種藥膏有助於傷口癒合。
The abolition of the old law pleased many citizens.
這條舊法律的廢除讓許多市民很高興。
Some people are calling for the abolition of school uniforms.
有些人呼籲廢除學校制服。

abolition.zh: 廢奴運動（廢除奴隸制度）
ai: The abolition of slavery changed the course of history.
奴隸制度的廢除改變了歷史的走向。
Many writers supported the abolition movement in the nineteenth century.
許多作家在十九世紀支持廢奴運動。
Linda teaches art at the local middle school.
琳達在當地國中教美術。
Linda made a lovely scarf for her friend.
琳達為她的朋友織了一條很漂亮的圍巾。
The guitarist played a beautiful solo in the middle of the song.
吉他手在歌曲中段彈了一段優美的獨奏。
She sang a solo at the school concert.
她在學校音樂會上獨唱了一首歌。
He is planning a solo trip around Europe.
他正在規劃一趟獨自遊歐洲的旅行。
This is her first solo album after leaving the band.
這是她離開樂團後的第一張個人專輯。
She flew solo across the country in a small plane.
她獨自駕著小飛機飛越全國。
He decided to travel solo this summer.
他決定今年夏天一個人旅行。

maid.zh: 女傭、女僕、客房清潔人員
ai: The maid cleaned all the rooms before noon.
客房清潔人員在中午前打掃完了所有房間。
In the old house, a maid brought tea to the guests.
在那棟老房子裡，一位女僕為客人端上了茶。
The hotel maid left fresh towels on the bed.
飯店的清潔人員在床上放了乾淨的毛巾。
The country's debt is more than a trillion dollars.
這個國家的債務超過一兆美元。
A trillion is a one followed by twelve zeros.
一兆是一後面跟著十二個零。
The army corps moved quickly across the river.
陸軍軍團迅速渡過了河。
My grandfather served in the Marine Corps.
我的祖父在海軍陸戰隊服過役。
The press corps waited outside for the president to speak.
媒體記者團在外面等待總統發言。
She joined the Peace Corps to teach in a small village.
她加入了和平工作團，到一個小村莊教書。
The police are investigating the homicide downtown.
警方正在調查市中心的那起兇殺案。
He was charged with homicide after the accident.
意外發生後，他被控殺人罪。
She works as a detective in the homicide department.
她在兇殺組擔任偵探。
The case was sent to homicide for further study.
這個案子被轉交給兇殺組進一步調查。
The teacher explained the grouping of students for the project.
老師說明了這次專題的學生分組方式。
This grouping of colors makes the room feel warm.
這種配色組合讓房間感覺很溫暖。
The grouping of words by topic helps me memorize them.
把單字依主題分組有助於我記憶。
Murray coaches the local youth basketball team.
默裡擔任當地青少年籃球隊的教練。
Murray asked me to join him for coffee.
默裡邀我跟他一起喝咖啡。

murray.zh: 墨累河（澳洲東南部的河流）
ai: The Murray is the longest river in Australia.
墨累河是澳洲最長的河流。
Farmers along the Murray depend on its water for their crops.
墨累河沿岸的農民依靠河水灌溉作物。
She is passionate about teaching young children.
她對教導幼童充滿熱忱。
